title: Plate Armour +2

fields.Defence: AC 20, Heavy Armour proficiency, Disadvantage on Stealth checks. Exceptional Plate reduces Slashing, Piercing and Bludgeoning damage by 2.
fields.Acquisition: Levelled magic armour traders at character level 11 or higher.
